using Raw = std::string
class Refusal : public std::runtime_error
  const char* word
  std::size_t offset
inline const std::vector<std::string> kLifecycleOperations
inline const std::vector<std::string> kFailureNames
struct NoticeMetadata
  bool quiet
  std::int64_t silence_ns
struct WatchOptions
  std::int64_t every_ns
  std::int64_t budget_ns
struct Stamp
  std::string value
inline std::string encode(const NoticeMetadata& v)
